ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (16) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

Henry George's «принадлежности убийства и грабежа» (prinadlezhnosti ubiystva i grabezha) is 'the implements of murder and robbery' and «себялюбие» (sebyalyubiye) is 'self-love'; in the Laozi passage «разумный» (razumny) is 'reasonable', not 'wise'. «Иноплеменник» (inoplemennik) is kept literal as 'a person of another tribe'.

Source observation: [11] The attribution «Лao-Тсе» (Lao-Tse, 'Laozi') is typed in mixed script, with Latin «ao» among Cyrillic letters (the same slip as in the 3 February file); the English reads 'Laozi.'
